protocol.purpose: descriptive development visualization; no inferential independence certification or promotion
protocol.features: all 56 fixed signed answer-z V_N56 channels, unchanged label-free signs
protocol.prediction: per-feature global Q80 of donor V values in four source folds; heldout V >= threshold
protocol.normalization: V is already signed per-answer z; no second normalization or label-oriented sign repair
protocol.split: unchanged five FOLDS_V2 source-disjoint folds, including controls among donors
protocol.evaluation: labels/types opened only after prediction seal
protocol.conditional_dependence: pairwise phi(E_i,E_j | Y=valid), separately phi(... | Y=error)
protocol.mi: empirical binary pair mutual information in bits, same class conditioning
protocol.undefined: zero class count or constant feature error margin => null, diagonal null; never imputed zero
protocol.aggregates: UI computes mean absolute phi over selected defined peers within each truth class; max of both class means requires both defined; display peer coverage
protocol.aggregation_warning: pairwise diagnostics are not mutual conditional independence; small estimates are not proof; no class/answer nuisance adjustment or confidence intervals
protocol.prmscore: pooled macro F1 valid/error excluding synthetic correct controls; per-type macro F1 except MS=valid-step F1
protocol.adaptation: NR/NCL official validity fallback; no separate redundancy head
protocol.family_summary: equal mean of member-feature PRMScores, not fused-family PRMScore
protocol.MS: all valid; error-conditioned dependence undefined; no AUC
